items.prompt: Why did you choose this venue for the school event?
items.answer: The hall that accommodates the most students seemed ideal.

items.prompt: There is a software update available for my university-issued laptop.
items.answer: Have you installed it yet?

items.prompt: I need to submit the project by Friday.
items.answer: Did you complete the final draft?

items.prompt: Did you see the latest episode of the series?
items.answer: No, I missed it because of a late class.

items.prompt: You missed the first part of the lecture this morning.
items.answer: Did the professor share the slides with the class?

items.prompt: Did you find the information you needed to complete the lab report?
items.answer: No I couldn't locate the guidelines for the data table.

items.prompt: Where did you find the instructions for the class assignment?
items.answer: The syllabus our professor gave us includes the instructions.

items.prompt: Why did the professor want to meet with you?
items.answer: She wasn't sure if everyone was aware of the updates.

items.prompt: I had to miss the literature class yesterday.
items.answer: Did you get the notes from someone?

items.prompt: I just finished reading the latest bestseller novel assigned for our literature class.
items.answer: Do you know if the author will be signing books this weekend?

items.prompt: I missed the last bus to school.
items.answer: Can you call a taxi instead?

items.prompt: I have a job interview for the school dining hall position soon.
items.answer: Did you prepare your answers to common interview questions?

items.prompt: What did the professor say about our group project?
items.answer: She wanted to discuss how we could improve our teamwork and time management.

items.prompt: Did you enjoy the drama club's performance last night?
items.answer: The storyline was not very compelling.

items.prompt: I heard there will be a workshop on creative writing next month.
items.answer: Do you know if the registration is open yet?
